stories.headline: Jenna Jameson gets married for the fourth time, weds Mil R. Ocampo after 1 year of dating - Page Six
stories.summary: The former adult film star hard-launched her romance with Ocampo just weeks after her last divorce.
stories.why: A cautionary tale about impulsive relationship decisions disguised as romance—Jameson's fourth marriage in rapid succession signals how even famous people can ignore red flags when caught in cycles of quick attachments.

stories.headline: ‘American Horror Story: 13’ Teaser Brings Back Jessica Lange and Rubber Man as FX Sets Release Dates for 13 Half-Hour Episodes - Variety
stories.summary: 'American Horror Story' Season 13 will consist of 13 half-hour episodes, three of which will air as the season premiere on Thursday, September 24.
stories.why: Jessica Lange's return to AHS signals prestige horror is back in vogue; if you dismissed the show as peak-era camp, the shortened episode format and OG cast suggest it's worth reconsidering as serious television.

stories.headline: ‘Coyote vs. Acme’ was canned by Warner Bros. But 3 years later, that’s not all folks - AP News
stories.summary: Like its ever-undaunted protagonist, “Coyote vs. Acme” is back from the dead. Three years ago, Warner Bros. decided to can the live-action, animation hybrid even though it was already completed. Afte…
stories.why: A completed film getting shelved then resurrected three years later exposes Hollywood's chaos—it's a reminder that studio decisions have nothing to do with quality, and patience sometimes pays off for projects you thought were dead.

stories.headline: 'Heated Rivalry' Actor Dylan Walsh 'in Trouble' Over Cameo Clip - Variety
stories.summary: “Heated Rivalry” actor Dylan Walsh has found himself on thin ice after revealing details about upcoming episodes in a video clip that has gone viral.
stories.why: A mainstream actor casually leaking spoilers in a Cameo video shows how digital side-hustles and loose social media culture are creating new professional liability; it's a cautionary moment about what 'off the clock' now means.

stories.headline: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Tapestry, Yeti, Bullish, StubHub, Cerebras & more - CNBC
stories.summary: These are the stocks posting the largest moves in the premarket.
stories.why: This headline is purely financial noise with no cultural relevance to entertainment or men's culture—it's stock market data, not a story.

stories.headline: Jenna Ortega’s sister reacts to fans’ concern over actress’ weight loss - Page Six
stories.summary: The “Wednesday” star went viral earlier this week for confessing she would go all day without eating or drinking on set as a child star.
stories.why: Ortega's admission about childhood disordered eating went viral because it names a systemic industry problem; her sister's defensive response reveals the generational tension between silence and accountability in Hollywood.

stories.headline: Nicole Kidman Reveals How Tom Cruise, Keith Urban Divorces Compare in Rare Comments - E! News
stories.summary: Nicole Kidman shared her candid outlook on her breakups from exes Tom Cruise and Keith Urban, whom she split from in 2001 and earlier this year, respectively.
stories.why: Kidman publicly comparing her divorces from Cruise and Urban is rare because A-listers almost never do this; it signals a shift toward normalizing post-divorce reflection rather than maintaining the strategic silence that used to define celebrity breakups.

stories.headline: Addiction Experts on Brad Pitt: “Alcoholics Are a Horrible Source of Information About Themselves” - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Experts react to Pitt revealing he’s “off the wagon,” and how the actor’s journey is very common — and not necessarily worrisome.
stories.why: Addiction experts publicly tempering expectations about Pitt's recovery acknowledges that celebrity sobriety narratives are often performative; it's a reality check on the redemption arc culture men are sold.
